event: Pennsylvania DEP received the plan approval application.
diligence_use: Start of the measured 228-day application-to-issuance interval.

event: DEP posted its draft plan approval for public review.
diligence_use: Public review milestone. Confirm the signed version before underwriting construction.

event: DEP held a public hearing on the draft.
diligence_use: Obtain the hearing and comment response record.

event: DEP issued plan approval for construction and conditional initial operation.
diligence_use: Covered seven combined-cycle turbines and up to ten simple-cycle turbines. Review conditions on temporary operation and emission reduction credits.

event: DEP issued a Title V renewal. Its technical memo documents removal of retired coal sources and approval for transfer and use of VOC credits.
diligence_use: Read the conditions and covered sources. The renewal records the credits required by the new gas plan.

event: The Environmental Hearing Board calendar listed a December 8 to 9 appeal hearing when checked November 23, 2026.
diligence_use: Check the docket close to the decision date for current scheduling and orders.
